items.markdown:
A salmon sperm facial is `a trendy skincare treatment that uses purified DNA fragments from salmon sperm to repair and rejuvenate the skin`.[[1]](https://dermoperfection.co.uk/salmon-sperm-facial-birmingham/)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4&t=1)

### What Is It?

- **Core Ingredient:** The treatment uses polydeoxyribonucleotide ([PDRN](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial) ), purified DNA extracted from salmon or trout sperm.
- **How It Works:** PDRN is applied topically with microneedling or injected into the skin to stimulate cell growth and healing.
- **Origin:** The technique started in South Korea and gained popularity worldwide through social media.[[1]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4&t=1)[[3]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)

### Benefits

- **Collagen Production:** Stimulates cells to make more collagen and elastin for firmer skin.
- **Hydration:** Improves skin moisture, tone, and texture.
- **Reduced Inflammation:** Helps calm irritated skin and speeds up tissue repair.[[1]](https://www.vogue.co.uk/article/salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=C4zqkmdQkw4&t=1)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[4]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)

### Risks and Costs

- **Cost:** Typically ranges from $500 to $1,000 per session.
- **Side Effects:** May cause temporary redness, swelling, or bruising.
- **Safety & Approval:** While popular in Europe and South Korea, injectable PDRN is not approved by the FDA in the United States, where it is usually applied topically instead. Avoid the treatment if you have a fish allergy.[[1]](https://www.drleah.co.uk/blog/post/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial)[[2]](https://www.everydayhealth.com/skin-care/what-is-a-salmon-sperm-facial/)[[3]](https://www.healthline.com/health/salmon-sperm-facial)[[4]](https://www.facebook.com/cnninternational/videos/salmon-sperm-facials-have-been-popularized-on-social-media-in-recent-years-but-h/816286211190484/)[[5]](https://simplyclinics.co.uk/treatment/salmon-sperm-facial-london/)
